title: Pickled Red Onions
subtitle: Quick-pickled, sharp, and bright, ready in 2 hours
excerpt: Pickled red onions use red wine vinegar and a little sugar. They're ready in 2 hours and will keep for 2 weeks in the fridge. No cooking needed. Makes one 500 ml jar.
sourceNotes: Classic British and Mediterranean quick pickle. The soaking in cold brine rather than hot vinegar keeps the onions crisp and vivid pink.

content.text: Pickled red onions require no cooking,  the vinegar does all the work. Sliced red onions go straight into a jar with red wine vinegar, a little sugar, and salt. After 2 hours they turn a vivid magenta-pink and are sharp, crunchy, and ready. They go on tacos, burgers, salads, cheese boards, and smoked salmon. Makes one 500 ml jar.

items.prepNote: about 2 large, thinly sliced into rings

content.text: Pack the sliced onions into a clean jar. Mix the vinegar, sugar, and salt together until the sugar and salt dissolve,  no heating needed. Add the black peppercorns if using. Pour the vinegar mixture over the onions. Push the onions down so they are submerged.

Leave at room temperature for a minimum of 2 hours before using. The onions will turn bright pink and soften slightly while keeping their crunch. For a softer, more fully pickled result, refrigerate overnight.

items.symptom: Onions have turned a dull brownish-pink
items.cause: White wine vinegar or malt vinegar used instead of red wine vinegar.
items.fix: The bright magenta colour comes specifically from red wine vinegar reacting with the red onion pigment. Use only red wine vinegar for this recipe.
Add another 0.5 tsp of sugar. Or blanch the sliced onions in boiling water for 30 seconds first to reduce their pungency.

items.cause: Onions cut too thin, or jar kept at room temperature too long.
items.fix: Slice onions 3 to 4 mm thick for a better texture that holds for 2 weeks. Always refrigerate after the first 2-hour room-temperature pickling period.

items.symptom: Onions not yet submerged in vinegar
items.cause: Jar not full enough, or too many onions packed in.
items.fix: Push down firmly with a spoon after pouring in the vinegar. If needed, add a splash more vinegar.

content.text: Refrigerate after the initial 2-hour pickling. Use within 2 weeks.
